recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the published FHIR-12536 wording across the active duplicated Medication domain boundary tables and aligns them with the already-correct MedicationStatement page.
issue_request: FHIR-12536 is a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request from DSTU2. It asked that the Medication domain boundary text for MedicationStatement include that the record can be derived from supporting information, for example Claim, Observation, or MedicationRequest.
initial_application: The January 2017 source commit 80a2e01af4c6892193a38f080d3ff9bc78489b5f, titled 'TR#12356 - updated boundaries for MedicationStatement', added the requested derived-supporting-information wording to source/medicationstatement/medicationstatement-introduction.xml. The current MedicationStatement page still has that wording and also points derived source records to MedicationStatement.derivedFrom. The copied MedicationStatement rows on the active MedicationRequest, MedicationDispense, and MedicationAdministration pages did not include the applied wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement as active resources, so their introduction XML files are in current build scope. FHIR-38682 later renamed MedicationUsage links back to MedicationStatement in the copied boundary rows, confirming the neighboring rows remained active but leaving the FHIR-12536 wording absent. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no human discussion or work-group record reversing the published Jira decision.
reconciliation: Added the approved derived-supporting-information phrase to the MedicationStatement row in the MedicationRequest, MedicationDispense, and MedicationAdministration boundary tables. No MedicationStatement-page edit was needed because that source already carried the applied wording.
source_changes: source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest-introduction.xml: added the derived-supporting-information phrase to the MedicationStatement row in the Boundaries and Relationships table.
source/medicationdispense/medicationdispense-introduction.xml: added the derived-supporting-information phrase to the MedicationStatement row in the Boundaries and Relationships table.
source/medicationadministration/medicationadministration-introduction.xml: added the derived-supporting-information phrase to the MedicationStatement row in the Boundaries and Relationships table.
